caption: The drawing depicts a single fire bucket with a rounded base, a wide opening, and a thick, curved handle attached on either side near the rim. The main color of the bucket is a weathered blue, with worn areas and visible texture suggesting age and use. The rim and base feature a decorative band with evenly spaced round metal rivets. The front of the bucket displays text: a large yellow “MOORESTOWN” at the bottom, a beige banner outlined in red with “UNION FIRE G” written on it toward the middle, and the uppermost banner in beige and black with the letters “C.H. FRENCH.” Decorative flourishes in yellow and red are present at the edges of the banners, and the text is hand-painted. The handle is painted in a brownish-gray hue, and the inner surface of the bucket is depicted in a muted, earthy tone. The background is plain and beige, and there is no additional context or objects in the composition. The artist’s name, Carl Burgerniss, is written in small print at the lower right of the image.
title: Fire Bucket
